text: Continuous Integration, or CI, is a common practice in modern software development. Whenever a developer adds new code to a shared project, automated builds start immediately. These builds compile the code and run tests to make sure everything works correctly. The main goal is catching issues early, before they become bigger problems. This saves time and reduces stress for the whole team. CI pipelines organise these steps into a clear process that runs automatically every time. As a result, teams can deliver better software faster and with more confidence.
